title: Pepper rice
summary: I love pepper lunch but every item on the menu...
extendedSummary: I love pepper lunch but every item on the menu is riddled with gluten. That didn't stop me during uni though... me and william's pepper lunch outings have probably caused irreversible damage to my small intestine. This recipe honestly tastes just as good as the real thing, and is so quick to make. If you are an og, you will top this with mozzarella cheese, and grab a side of kimchi (the cheese sounds foul but trust it is actually super yummy).

items: 1 small fillet of steak, sliced super thinly against the grain

method: Preheat cast iron skillet or any skillet with enough oil to lightly grease the bottom of the skillet over medium-high heat
Add the onions and sauté for 2-3 minutes or until onions start to soften

Once onions have soften, scoot onions the the middle of the skillet, and then place the thinly sliced beef around the perimeter of the skillet. Let the beef sit for a couple minutes and then scoot the onions to the perimeter of the skillet alongside the beef.
Next add the rice to the middle of the skillet where the well was created.
Top the rice with the butter (the more butter the more rich and decadent the dish) and then add the corn and green onions on top.
Add the Beef Pepper Rice sauce to the skillet and then mix everything together until well combined.
